summary: The rows of middleBaseChange(π̄)·l are l_i (i ≠ k₀), π·l_{k₀} and −π̄⁻¹·l_{k₀}; compare integrality row by row.

steps.claim: Unfolding the matrices, integrality of middleBaseChange(π̄)·l means: the rows l_i (i ≠ k₀), π·l_{k₀} = conj(π̄)·l_{k₀} and π̄⁻¹·l_{k₀} are integral; membership in π̄Ô is rewritten as integrality after division by π̄.
Both claims follow: π̄ and π = conj(π̄) are integral, products of integral adeles are integral, and π·l_{k₀} = ππ̄·(π̄⁻¹l_{k₀}).
